## [Talos 1.14.4](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.4) (2026-10-16) Welcome to the v1.14.4 release of Talos! Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/issues. ### Component Updates Linux: 6.18.57 Talos is built with Go 1.26.9. ### Contributors * Andrey Smirnov ### Changes
1 commit

* siderolabs/talos@3fb46c378 release(v1.14.4): prepare release

### Changes from siderolabs/pkgs
2 commits

* siderolabs/pkgs@2ec10eb chore: update DRBD compat * siderolabs/pkgs@643b731 feat: update Linux to 6.18.57

### Dependency Changes * **github.com/siderolabs/pkgs** v1.14.0-42-g5fa47d1 -> v1.14.0-44-g2ec10eb Previous release can be found at [v1.14.3](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.3) ## Images ``` ghcr.io/siderolabs/flannel:0.28.9 registry.k8s.io/coredns/coredns:v1.14.7 registry.k8s.io/etcd:v3.7.2 registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10.2 registry.k8s.io/kube-apiserver:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-controller-manager:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-scheduler:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-proxy:v1.37.1 ghcr.io/siderolabs/kubelet:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/networking/kube-network-policies:v1.1.2 ghcr.io/siderolabs/installer-base:v1.14.4 ghcr.io/siderolabs/imager:v1.14.4 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talos:v1.14.4 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talosctl-all:v1.14.4 ghcr.io/siderolabs/overlays:v1.14.4 ghcr.io/siderolabs/extensions:v1.14.4 ```
